audit.whatIsWrong: The on-disk level chart reads Riven, Riven, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill in both layers - it hands Mordekaiser or a coinflip five of seven stages while Riven wins 55.14% over 1694 games, and the packet chart says Skill, Riven, Riven, Riven, Mordekaiser, Riven, Riven.
audit.why: The page's own whys already describe the packet's chart: whys[0] says neither side has a Level 1 edge (Skill), whys[2] and whys[3] say he is a sitting target through Levels 3-5 (Riven), whys[4] says Realm of Death inverts the duel (Mordekaiser), whys[5] and whys[6] say Eclipse and two items break him (Riven). Only the win/side tokens disagreed with the prose above them. The mordekaiser__riven mirror audit flipped exactly these six rows to the same values, so restating them here keeps the two directions identical.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 flipped as one atomic paired group in both layers to Skill, Riven, Riven, Riven, Mordekaiser, Riven, Riven, with phases ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text carried no real cooldown numbers, so 'track his R' and 'trade when his E is down' were untimeable.
audit.why: Realm of Death is 140/120/100s, Death's Grasp is 16/14/12/10/8s, Indestructible is 12/11/10/9/8s and Obliterate is 8/7/6/5/4s at 675 range. Riven's Blade of the Exile is 120/90/60s, so at rank 1 her ult comes back before his does - that is the whole reason Levels 6 onward still favour her once the first R is spent.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into whys[3], whys[4] and the first-item spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Indestructible (W) is described only as 'his healing from W' and Grievous Wounds is absent from the content layer entirely.
audit.why: Indestructible stores damage dealt and taken as a shield he can consume as a heal, on an 8-12s cooldown - it is the single thing that beats Riven's chip-and-reset pattern in an extended trade, and anti-heal is what turns it off.
audit.corrected: First-item spike now names Indestructible, its cooldown and the Executioner's Calling timing.

audit.why: The kit file tags Obliterate (Q) with a 'grounding' flag, but Riot's own description for Obliterate says only that he smashes the ground for damage, increased against a single target - no dash denial. Per the rule that the description beats a derived flag, I did not write any grounding claim into the page, and no advice should be built on Riven's dashes being shut off by his Q.
55.14% over 1694 games matches the FAV / 6-in-10 framing already on the page.

edits.before: Your Q resets win level 1 if you weave autos between casts. Identify how Mordekaiser contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Q resets contest level 1 but Darkness Rise arms on three hits — even. Identify how Mordekaiser contests the first waves before you commit anything.

edits.before: His E pull is the only setup tool and if you dodge it with your own E every trade, Levels 4-5 are a sustained torture session of short burst windows that he cannot answer.
edits.after: Death's Grasp (E) is his only setup tool and it is down 10-14s once you dodge it with your own E — Levels 4-5 become a run of short burst windows he cannot answer at all.

edits.before: Realm of Death inverts the duel — his W shield refuels, your stats are partially stolen, and Wind Slash alone cannot burst him before he heals back. Never take this fight low.
edits.after: Realm of Death, 140s at rank 1, inverts the duel — Indestructible refuels, your stats are partly stolen, and Wind Slash alone cannot burst him before he heals. Never take it low.

edits.before: Eclipse spike is your window to bully him off waves and force all-ins strictly on Realm of Death's cooldown — his healing from W cannot out-sustain your burst when he is not in his R.
edits.after: Buy Executioner's Calling on the way to Eclipse: Indestructible (W) is an 8-12s shield he cashes in as a heal, and Grievous Wounds is what makes your burst stick outside his R.

notes: Packet suspectName 'Realm of Death's' is a FALSE POSITIVE - it is the correct ability name with a possessive, and the same string appears throughout the full layer. The kit file's 'grounding' flag on Obliterate (Q) contradicts Riot's own description of that ability; I trusted the description and wrote no grounding claim, but the flag should be reviewed at source since other agents may act on it. Content layer is otherwise factually clean - every ability name matched Riot's text - so the work here was the chart and the numbers. Chart rows proposed as one atomic paired group across both layers, matching the mordekaiser__riven mirror exactly.
